messages:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks everyone — leaving a short follow-up thread for quick clarifications from today's all-hands about mission framing and competitor Qs. Post short Qs and I'll reply.
Priya (sales): What's a 15s exec response for "Why Redwood vs cloud-managed endpoints"?
Aisha (CEO): 15s: 'We productize inference: predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) that meet SLA and compliance needs.' Keep it outcomes-first.
Tom (VP Product): Add that rollouts + quality monitoring are baked in — enterprises care about risk controls.
Kai (eng): For demos, can we have one verified stat that reps can memorize? Something crisp.
Jules (research): Also: policy Q — will hosted only include models with permissive licenses?
Leah (legal): Hosted requires license compatibility; Dedicated/Private can BYO under a verified compatibility & safety checklist. We'll circulate the policy doc tomorrow.
Priya (sales): Is it OK to say "single-tenant SLA" in outbound? Need an approved short phrase.
Aisha (CEO): Use this factual phrasing: 'dedicated deployments with SLA-backed latency targets.' Avoid name-calling.
Kai (eng): Roadmap tradeoff: kernel/quant optimizations vs customer-facing features (reranking, eval tooling) — which takes priority this quarter?
Aisha (CEO): Prioritize infra optimizations that materially improve cost/latency for paying customers. Feature work follows once perf baseline is solid.
Tom (VP Product): I'll publish a one-page decision matrix for PMs/eng by EOD to make prioritization clear.
Priya (sales): One-liner rebuttal for "we'll just self-host open models"?
Aisha (CEO): 'Self-hosting transfers long-term ops, reliability, and quality risk to your team. We deliver those primitives as a product so you can focus on product instead of infra.' Short + empathetic.
Jules (research): For external positioning, should we use 'inference platform' or 'inference runtime'?
Sergio (GTM): Customer-facing: 'inference platform' (broader product idea). Technical collateral can mention 'runtime' where precise.
support-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://internal.redwood.example/all-hands/2823456789 :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks — I'll post the battlecard, the SLO templates, and the verified demo stat link in this thread shortly. Closing this thread. — Aisha
